description.value:
You descended from the Dragon King. Your scales gleam with a metallic sheen, resembling gold, silver, bronze, copper or brass (or the exceedingly rare platinum with the GM’s permission). During your daily preparations, you can choose one of the following cantrips: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Qw3fnUlaUbnn7ipC]{Prestidigitation}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yvs1zN5Pai5U4CJX]{Summon Instrument} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.pwzdSlJgYqN7bs2w]{Telekinetic Hand}. You can cast this cantrip as an innate arcane spell until your next daily preparations. The cantrip is automatically leveled up to half of your level rounded up.

Automatic spellcasting entry creation is not implemented yet.
